text: 金十数据7月16日讯，英国5月经济数据显示，GDP环比增长0.1%，符合市场预期。数据公布后，英镑走势基本持稳，市场关注焦点仍集中于英国政局。Ebury分析师Samuel Edwards在报告中表示，最新数据凸显英国经济复苏仍然十分脆弱。近期中东紧张局势再度升级，使企业持续处于高度警惕状态。周四稍早，在媒体报道称英国候任首相伯纳姆可能任命不太支持扩张性财政政策的现任内政大臣马哈茂德担任财政大臣后，欧元兑英镑一度跌至13个月新低。
text_en: Jinshi Data July 16 - UK May economic data shows GDP grew 0.1% month-on-month, in line with market expectations. The pound held steady after the data release, with market focus remaining on UK politics. Ebury analyst Samuel Edwards said in a report that the latest data highlights the fragility of the UK's economic recovery. Recent escalation of tensions in the Middle East has kept businesses on high alert. Earlier on Thursday, after media reports that UK Prime Minister-elect Burnham may appoint current Home Secretary Mahmood, who is less supportive of expansionary fiscal policy, as Chancellor, EUR/GBP briefly fell to a 13-month low.
